items.name: Finset.mem_Iic
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] {a x : α} : x ∈ Finset.Iic a ↔ x ≤ a

items.name: Nat.cast_mem_Iic_iff
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [FloorSemiring α] {b : α} {n : ℕ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) : ↑n ∈ Set.Iic b ↔ n ∈ Finset.Iic ⌊b⌋₊
